original_test_intent: Upgrade host BIOS through the supported BMC path, preserve intended settings, and verify target version plus successful host boot and inventory.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: BMC WebUI uploads `.ima`, selects Preserve all Configuration, flashes, and verifies BIOS version.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Target BIOS is active, settings are preserved as approved, and host platform is healthy.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with component, image, setting, activation and boot-health controls.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer operates WebUI unless the exact platform has an approved update API; agent may prepare checks and analyze results.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: WebUI `.ima` BIOS upgrade with preserve-all behavior.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Board/component identity, signed image and compatibility, preservation matrix, activation/reboot, rollback and approval.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Alternate interfaces must retain BIOS component, setting and post-boot coverage.

original_method: Original WebUI BIOS upgrade flow remains visible and unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the vendor-advertised BIOS update service or the original WebUI path for the exact platform; validate component inventory and task semantics first.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Current/target BIOS and BMC compatibility required.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor BIOS update manual; advertised Redfish UpdateService documentation if applicable.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Potential API orchestration only when feature-equivalent; no generic endpoint substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must retain preservation, activation, POST/boot and full inventory checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Component/image IDs, settings matrix and activation plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong image or interrupted activation can prevent host boot.

missing_inputs: Signed compatible BIOS image and component ID
safety_boundaries: No power interruption, automatic retry or unapproved default reset
expected_evidence: POST/boot plus CPU/memory/PCIe/storage/GPU/network and log health
no_automatic_retry: Failed BIOS update/boot requires explicit recovery approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: BIOS/platform engineer issues the formal result.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already separated execution capability from image/readiness approval and preserved WebUI functional coverage.
